test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 60
 152
 161
 
 

 14
 18
 17
 
 

 15
 19
 ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Column = Third number × (Second number - 10) = First number**

 
• Column 1: 15 × (14 - 10) = 15 × 4 = 60
 
• Column 2: 19 × (18 - 10) = 19 × 8 = 152

Similarly,

 
• Column 3: ? × (17 - 10) = 161
 
 
• ? × 7 = 161
 
• ? = 161 ÷ 7
 
• ? = 23
 
 

Hence, '**23**' is the correct answer.
